name: compute_balanced_ration
description: MANDATORY for final ration advice. Runs least-cost linear programming on 270+ feed library with INAPH minimum nutrition (TDN, CP, Ca, P), DM limits, concentrate cap, forage + mineral. Call as soon as district, state, animal profile, and at least 2 current feeds with quantities are known. Do not re-ask feed names already provided. Feed prices are optional and estimated if missing. Returns kilogram/day per feed and daily cost in rupees.

lang.description: Language code: hi, en, gu, mr, etc.

weight_kg.description: Body weight in kg, estimate if unknown

calvings.description: Number of calvings / times bachha hua

in_milk.description: True if animal is giving milk now

feeds_json.description: JSON array of feeds farmer already said they use, e.g. [{"name":"wheat straw","qty_kg":5,"price_rs":4}]. Include every feed already mentioned. price_rs optional — regional library rate used if missing or zero.

neighborhood_feeds_json.description: REQUIRED on second call after farmer names local feeds. JSON array e.g. [{"name":"hybrid napier grass"}]. Same animal + feeds_json as first call.

local_feed_names.description: Easier alternative on second call: comma-separated local feed names the farmer said, e.g. hybrid napier grass
